title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21

ai_review.summary: A mostly praised 9/21/73 performance featuring a smoking Casey Jones and new horns, but the tape is cut short, leaving the recording incomplete.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this show’s energy – especially the lone Casey Jones track and the surprise horn section that makes 9/21/73 “freaking smoke.” However, the recording suffers from a noticeable edit that chops the song halfway through the second chorus, which some listeners find disappointing. Overall the musical vibe is celebrated even though the audio source is incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: Three out of four reviewers gave 5‑star praise for the performance, while one flagged a serious cut in the tape; weighting show quality heavily yields a high rating, but recording issues keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Track is truncated halfway through the second chorus and resumes only with the tail end; no explicit comments on clarity or mix, suggesting a basic audience tape with edit problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only one song is represented in this upload, but listeners recall a long late‑night show (7 pm–2 am) that featured an exciting horn addition and high energy throughout.
